SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ua1.unit_id) AS improved_taluks
FROM unit_assessments ua1
JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua1.unit_id
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
JOIN unit_assessments ua2 ON ua1.unit_id = ua2.unit_id AND ua1.assessment_year = ua2.assessment_year
WHERE s.state_name = 'MAHARASHTRA'
AND u.unit_type = 'TALUK'
AND ua1.assessment_year = '2023-2024'
AND ua2.assessment_year = '2021-2022'
AND ua1.category = 'Critical'
AND ua2.category = 'Over-Exploited'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS improved_units
FROM unit_assessments ua
JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
WHERE s.state_name = 'MAHARASHTRA'
AND ua.assessment_year IN ('2021-2022', '2023-2024')
AND u.unit_type = 'TALUK'
AND ua.category IN ('Safe', 'Semi-Critical', 'Critical')
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unit_assessments ua_prev
    JOIN assessment_units u_prev ON u_prev.unit_id = ua_prev.unit_id
    JOIN districts d_prev ON d_prev.district_id = u_prev.district_id
    JOIN states s_prev ON s_prev.state_id = u_prev.state_id
    WHERE s_prev.state_name = 'MAHARASHTRA'
    AND u_prev.unit_type = 'TALUK'
    AND ua_prev.assessment_year = '2021-2022'
    AND ua_prev.unit_id = ua.unit_id
    AND ua_prev.category != ua.category
)

    districts d
JOIN 
    district_assessments d2021 ON d.district_id = d2021.district_id AND d2021.assessment_year = '2021-2022'

JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
WHERE s.state_name = 'MAHARASHTRA' AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited'

SELECT 
  assessment_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ua.unit_id) AS count
FROM 
  unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
  assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN 
  districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN 
  states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
WHERE 
  s.state_name = 'MADHYA PRADESH'
  AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited'
  AND ua.assessment_year IN ('2019-2020', '2021-2022', '2022-2023', '2023-2024', '2024-2025')
GROUP BY 
  assessment_year
ORDER BY 
  assessment_year

SELECT 
    u.unit_name,
    ua1.category AS category_2021_22,
    ua2.category AS category_2022_23,
    ua1.extraction_total_ham AS extraction_2021_22,
    ua2.extraction_total_ham AS extraction_2022_23
FROM 
    unit_assessments ua1
JOIN 
    assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua1.unit_id
JOIN 
    districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN 
    states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
JOIN 
    unit_assessments ua2 ON ua2.unit_id = ua1.unit_id AND ua2.assessment_year = '2022-2023'
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'WEST BENGAL'
    AND ua1.assessment_year = '2021-2022'
    AND ua1.category != ua2.category
    AND ua2.extraction_total_ham > ua1.extraction_total_ham * 1.1

SELECT 
    u.unit_name,
    ua.category,
    ua.extraction_total_ham AS extraction_total_ham_2021_2022,
    ua2.extraction_total_ham AS extraction_total_ham_2022_2023,
    ua.stage_of_extraction_pct AS stage_of_extraction_pct_2021_2022,
    ua2.stage_of_extraction_pct AS stage_of_extraction_pct_2022_2023
FROM 
    unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
    assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN 
    districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN 
    states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
JOIN 
    unit_assessments ua2 ON ua.unit_id = ua2.unit_id
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'WEST BENGAL'
    AND u.unit_type = 'BLOCK'
    AND ua.assessment_year = '2021-2022'
    AND ua2.assessment_year = '2022-2023'
    AND ua.extraction_total_ham > 0
    AND ua2.extraction_total_ham > ua.extraction_total_ham * 1.1
    AND ua.stage_of_extraction_pct > 10
    AND ua2.stage_of_extraction_pct > 10

SELECT 
    u.unit_name,
    ua.category,
    ua.extraction_total_ham
FROM 
    unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
    assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN 
    districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN 
    states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'WEST BENGAL'
    AND ua.assessment_year IN ('2021-2022', '2022-2023')
    AND ua.category IN ('Critical', 'Over-Exploited', 'Saline', 'Hilly Area')
    AND ua.extraction_total_ham > (
        SELECT 
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM assessment_year) - 1 || '-' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM assessment_year)
        FROM 
            assessment_years
        WHERE 
            assessment_year = '2021-2022'
    )
ORDER BY 
    ua.assessment_year, ua.extraction_total_ham DESC

SELECT 
    u.unit_name, 
    u.unit_type, 
    ua.category, 
    ua.extraction_total_ham, 
    ua.stage_of_extraction_pct
FROM 
    unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
    assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN 
    districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN 
    states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'WEST BENGAL'
    AND (
        (ua.assessment_year = '2021-2022' AND ua.category = 'Critical') 
        OR 
        (ua.assessment_year = '2022-2023' AND ua.category = 'Critical')
    )
    AND ua.stage_of_extraction_pct > 10
